text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: We totally got crushed out there!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If we threw, it got caught! If we dodged, 
they chased us down! 
That loud laughter closing in from behind 
was so terrifying it even showed up in my 
dreams last night!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I know what you mean~! It was super 
scary! 
I felt like, 'So this is what it's like to 
be chased by a real demon!'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The passes from the other team were so 
fast too. 
Once we were caught in a pincer attack, I 
didn't even know which way to run.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In the end, our score was zero. At this 
point in time, accomplishing 
the mission "Win Demon Dodgeball" is 
deemed extremely difficult.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I figured as much~. First off, we've gotta 
work hard 
just to be able to catch one of those 
attacks!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The folks from the shopping district are 
coming to cheer us on, after all. 
Aaaah~~, but how can we get better?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. 
I apologize for being late; preparations 
took longer than expected.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday's practice match was very 
fruitful. Thanks to it, creating our list 
of improvements 
went smoothly—and I've put together a 
great training regimen!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's just a matter of how efficiently 
we can practice until the Fan Appreciation 
Day. 
I'm so looking forward to starting our 
training—is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, no! You just looked so happy, 
Ikuno-chan... 
that it kind of caught me off guard.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Happy... Yes, I suppose so. Experiencing 
actual competition and establishing 
concrete 
goals was exceptionally beneficial. All 
that remains is execution.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing... Meanwhile, I don't even 
have 
the faintest clue how we're supposed to 
win.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The difference in skill was certainly 
evident. 
However, at this point, that is entirely 
natural.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By playing against the favorites to win, 
you were able to clearly see 
what issues we need to address. However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Looked at another way, that means we still 
have plenty of room to grow. 
Doesn't thinking about how much stronger 
we can become get you excited?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We are still works in progress. 
Now, everyone, let's put our all into 
today's practice!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the shuttle runs. Please 
make sure you are able to 
turn off either leg—begin.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Turn back—!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... I see. The reason 'Penta' moved so 
quickly 
was because they were so good at tight 
turns like this...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Baku-chan, incoming!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oryaaah! BAKUSHIN ATTACK!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, Baku-chan! 
Your attacks are getting stronger and 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaahahahaha! This is the splendid result 
of the Class Rep's potential 
stretching to its absolute limits!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I tried copying Team Penta's captain, and 
I feel like 
my throws have been getting more powerful 
bit by bit!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The handouts Ikuno-san provided on 
"Effective Ball Gripping for Power 
Transfer" 
and "Arm Trajectory for Maximizing 
Velocity" were also very informative.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Improvement in stat values confirmed. —We 
can do this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pheeew~~, another exhausting day.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work over 
consecutive days of training. I've 
prepared some compress patches. 
Please use them if you're experiencing any 
muscle soreness or bruises.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you! Since we're using 
different muscles from racing, 
I've been getting sore in the weirdest 
places.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, I truly feel we are growing 
stronger step by step! 
Let us continue to Bakushin in a straight 
line toward victory!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Team status updated to: "Good Condition." 
If we continue training at this rate, we 
can face the actual event with pride.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A practice match with the favorites was a 
rather drastic measure, 
but it seems everyone has thoroughly 
absorbed the experience.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Ikuno, can I say one thing?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've... really wanted to tell you this, 
Ikuno. 
Thank you so much for all your help with 
our Demon Dodgeball practice!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
After that practice match, I didn't know 
what I was supposed to do. 
I knew we couldn't stay the way we were, 
but my mind went totally blank...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yet even while I was frozen in place, you 
were already figuring out 
how we could win. You showed me the path 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Getting better little by little right now 
is all thanks to you, Ikuno. 
So I'm going to put my trust in you, and 
get way, way stronger!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my gratitude as well. 
Like Tannhauser-san, following the match 
I possessed no scheme for achieving the 
mission objective of "Victory"...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, by learning the ideal movements 
from Team Penta 
and performing the training Ikuno-san 
devised, I have confirmed a clear 
improvement in skill.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Currently, the team's status continues to 
register as "Good Condition." 
At this rate, I am confident we can aim 
for "Victory."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I want to win too. At first, it 
was just a simple wish 
to play outdoor games that I never got to 
do as a kid.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Getting stronger together is fun. That's 
why I want to win. 
Together with everyone on this team that 
Ikuno-chan supported and made strong.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In Kyoto Turf 3200m terms, we have only 
just begun our ascent up the first hill! 
Giving up here would be a disgrace to all 
stayers!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Yes. Don't worry, we can still 
become much stronger. 
Let us continue our training and face the 
big day with no regrets!
